verdict.rationale: AMD documents a public software stack (ROCm) with APIs/libraries (HIP, PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX/ONNX/vLLM/llama.cpp integration) that let developers programmatically drive the GPU for AI workloads, and llms.txt is served for documentation discovery. However, there is no dedicated machine-callable REST/OpenAPI interface — the openapi probe returned 404 on all candidate paths — so an AI agent cannot invoke a structured public API directly, only use ROCm's compiled libraries/frameworks. Missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI or similarly agent-consumable API endpoint, independent confirmation of programmatic control beyond framework bindings.
